jobs.title: Solution Architect (AI Platform)
jobs.description:
About the role
  
  

A Singapore public sector agency is building an AI\-powered document processing and case intelligence platform on AWS GCC, integrating with an existing OutSystems case management system. You'll own the end\-to\-end architecture and act as technical lead for the squad.
  
  

Key responsibilities
  
  

Own the end\-to\-end solution architecture, including the design of the agentic AI architecture, ensuring detailed design and development align with the client's Enterprise Architecture
  
  

Translate business requirements, including application resiliency requirements, into application architectural specifications
  
  

Propose products and solutions based on the client's Enterprise Architecture and standards
  
  

Design the architecture blueprint of the organisation's business, information and ICT assets using multiple architectural models
  
  

Use, govern and enhance the architecture blueprint to ensure business and ICT remain in alignment
  
  

Review source code and solutions as part of the software development lifecycle
  
  

Provide delivery oversight and governance through solution architecture reviews, tech reviews, sprint reviews and Architecture Review Board submissions
  
  

About you
  
  

Minimum 4 years' relevant working experience
  
  

Track record in architecture design and technical leadership, particularly system architecture ownership, documentation and Architecture Review Board (ARB) clearance
  
  

**Track record in agentic AI system design:** multi\-agent pipelines, Bedrock AgentCore, orchestration and MCP Server, RAG knowledge bases, human\-in\-the\-loop architecture
  
  

Demonstrated experience in cloud\-native architecture on AWS GCC for infrastructure and security — VPC, IAM, WOG AD FS, IM8/GCC compliance
  
  

Expert\-level OutSystems, sufficient to lead integration with an existing case management system
  
  

Experience developing systems handling sensitive and personal data
  
  

In\-depth understanding of a legal, regulatory or compliance operations domain
  
  

Excellent data modelling and SQL skills
  
  

Solid understanding of server\-side .NET and/or Java development, service\-oriented architectures, web services and public\-facing web/e\-services development
  
  

Strong technical judgement to determine the best solution to a technical problem
  
  

Added advantage
  
  

Experience in a legal or regulatory domain, with the credibility to engage stakeholders directly
  
  

Experience working on case management, compliance or enforcement systems in a regulatory context
  
  

Prior experience architecting on OutSystems, and/or architecting applications designed to operate as part of a larger shared platform
  
  

Neutron Pte. Ltd. is a software consultancy firm at the forefront of digital transformation. Our strength lies in user\-centric product design and data\-driven analysis, harmonized with a commitment to cybersecurity. Leveraging innovative technologies, we offer customized solutions that propel growth and efficiency. Neutron Pte. Ltd. \- your trusted partner in navigating the digital landscape.

Knowledge on CSS, JavaScript, and a good understanding of UI/UX concepts and design frameworks.
  
  

Knowledge on MS Fabric
  
  

Good understanding of RDBMS.
  
  

Experience working in both Agile and Waterfall delivery models.
  
  

Certifications on Microsoft technologies, eg PL\-900 \- Power platform fundamentals and AZ\-900: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals will be preferred

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?
At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life\-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.
Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.
Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (Sequencing Instrument Platform)  



  

**Position Summary**

The Senior Mechanical Design Engineer in Illumina’s R\&D department will lead and contribute to the development of new, industry\-leading genetic analysis platforms for life sciences and clinical markets. The engineer will be responsible for design of DNA sequencing equipment that includes complex optical, mechanical, electrical, chemical, and software sub\-systems. The engineer will be responsible for participating in and coordinating cross\-functional teams, developing plans, performing analysis, and innovating new technologies.  



  

**Job duties and responsibilities include:**

* Uncover product requirements and translate requirements into subsystem specifications.
* Design precision electro\-mechanical and fluidic mechanisms.
* Work in concurrent, cross\-functional teams.
* Actively seek out and collect input from stakeholders across supporting disciplines.
* Manage outsourced design and manufacturing relationships.
* Compare performance and cost of design options in a data driven manner.
* Perform mechanical and thermal analysis of subsystem / system designs.
* Create schedules and manage actions to meet milestones.
* Perform risk analysis, develop test plans, and execute verification testing of subsystems and systems.
* Follow through on transfer of new products into manufacturing, track issues in manufacturing and the field, and implement resolution of issues.
* Propose and investigate new architecture, technologies and products that enable the goals of Illumina’s product portfolio.
* Candidates must thrive in a dynamic environment and place great emphasis on meeting milestones and breaking down barriers to achieve results.
* Candidate would be required to travel to US for work purposes

All listed tasks and responsibilities are deemed as essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodation for additional tasks and responsibilities.  



  

**Preferred:**

* Experience in biomedical instruments, biological assays, and/or genetic analysis equipment is preferred.
Experience in FDA regulated markets is a plus.  
* 

  

**Education and experience:**

* BS/MS/PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or related and \>5 years industry experience.
* Candidate must have experience in product development, transfer to manufacturing, and documentation.
* Candidate must have a proven track record in designing robust electro\-mechanical systems which may include imaging, dynamic motion control, fluidics components, and thermal control.
* Demonstrated knowledge of mechanical engineering design principles and practices \- Form, fit, tolerance stack analysis, GD\&T, drafting standards, FEA, design for assembly, design for manufacturing, etc.
* Experience with a wide variety of manufacturing processes (low, medium, and high volume).
* Selection of electromechanical components such as motors, power transmission components and sensors.
* Evaluation and optimization of complex tolerance budgets.
* Candidate must have strong project management skills and interpersonal, relationship\-building skills.
* Fluent in SolidWorks CAD software and one or more mechanical FEA packages.

All listed requirements are deemed essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodation for additional tasks and responsibilities.  



  

**ATTITUDE/ATTRIBUTES:**

* Ability and willingness to make an impact
* Creativity of thought and mindset
* Thrives in a dynamic and fast paced environment
A passion for discovery  
* 

  

We are a company deeply rooted in belonging, promoting an inclusive environment where employees feel valued and empowered to contribute to our mission. Built on a strong foundation, Illumina has always prioritized openness, collaboration, and seeking alternative perspectives to propel innovation in genomics. We are proud to confirm a zero\-net gap in pay, regardless of gender, ethnicity, or race. We also have several Employee Resource Groups (ERG) that deliver career development experiences, increase cultural awareness, and offer opportunities to engage in social responsibility. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status, and genetic information. Illumina conducts background checks on applicants for whom a conditional offer of employment has been made. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws. Background check results may potentially result in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment. The background check process and any decisions made as a result shall be made in accordance with all applicable local, state, and federal laws. Illumina prohibits the use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in the application and interview process. If you require accommodation to complete the application or interview process, please contact accommodations@illumina.com. To learn more, visit: https://www.dol.gov/ofccp/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/eeopost.pdf. jobs.description:

At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life\-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.
Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.
**Job Description**

  

**Position Summary**  

We are seeking a highly motivated, self\-driven and energetic individual to join our Electrical Engineering team at our Singapore design facility. You willbecome a member of Illumina’s award\-winning team doing cutting\-edge development of sequencing instruments – and enjoy a fast\-paced dynamicenvironment and a culture of open communication and mutual respect! The Electrical Engineering team defines, develops, and commercializes our designsfor new, industry\-leading sequencing instruments for life sciences and clinical markets.  



  

**Responsibilities** :


* Perform board\-level design with significant challenges related to complexity, power, size and thermal management
* Execute parameter analysis, system modelling, board simulation, board bring\-up and troubleshooting
* Work on and contribute to electronics related areas such as power systems, cabling, communication, safety, and control systems
* Deep dive on failure analysis at board and system level, and lead both short term containment and permanent solutions
* Independently drive the development of sequencing instruments with a focus on Electrical Engineering within Embedded Systems
* Own the design and implementation of instrument\-level telemetry systems in collaboration with subject matter experts, firmware, and software teams
* Develop and enhance analysis and support tools for monitoring and evaluating instrument performance data
* Identify potential electromagnetic interference (EMI) and compatibility (EMC) issues and provide technical recommendations for mitigation strategies during design and testing
* Work with cross\-functional teams on optimizing performance, reliability, and cost
* Define and implement processes to improve project execution
* Contribute to the development of appropriate product design user needs, requirements, specifications, and traceability throughout the product lifecycle
* Execute specific deliverables associated with development of RUO and/or IVD products, including but not limited to design verification, specification management, and traceability.
* Work with subject matter experts to drive execution of project risk management activities in compliance with the risk management process and industry best practices (FMEAs, Hazard Analysis, etc.).

All listed tasks and responsibilities are deemed as essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodations for additional tasks and responsibilities.  



  

**Requirements:**

* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in Electrical Engineering or equivalent
* Strong knowledge in analog, digital, and mixed signal circuit design
* Working knowledge of system design, simulation, and modelling
* Strong knowledge of data analysis
* Knowledge and experience in cable assembly and wire harness design
* Working knowledge of applicable industry standards including IEEE, ISO and NEMA
* Working knowledge in firmware and software
* Ability to guide other multi\-discipline design teams to ensure successful project execution.
* Collaborates, builds relationships, and influences team members to work towards common goals
* Excellent written and oral communication and presentation skills

All listed requirements are deemed as essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodations for additional tasks and responsibilities.  



  

**Education**

BS degree in Electrical Engineering with 5\+ years’ industry experience, or MS degree with 3\+ years’ industry experience.

jobs.title: Technical Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
**The Role**
------------



The Technical Operations Engineer is responsible for maintaining operational excellence across systems, processes, and technology platforms. This role focuses on incident management, operational monitoring, process optimization, stakeholder support, and continuous improvement to ensure reliable business and customer operations.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------



Operations Management

* Be on rotation for availability incidents and provide support for customer service engineers.
* Proactively develop scripts and tools to prevent incidents from ever happening.
* Monitor and maintain daily operational performance of systems and services.
* Ensure timely resolution of operational issues and service disruptions.
* Manage operational workflows and process adherence.

  

Incident \& Escalation Management

* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams during incidents and escalations.
* Conduct root cause analysis and implement preventive actions.

  

Process Improvement

* Identify inefficiencies and recommend automation opportunities.
* Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Drive operational excellence initiatives and continuous improvement projects.

  

Data Analysis \& Reporting

* Monitor and report on operational KPIs and service metrics.
* Analyze trends, risks, and performance gaps.
* Prepare dashboards and management reports.

  

Stakeholder Collaboration

* Partner with Engineering, Product, Customer Support, and Business Operations teams.
* Provide operational guidance and technical support to stakeholders.
* Communicate status updates and recommendations effectively.

  

Compliance \& Risk Management

* Ensure compliance with operational policies and security standards.
* Identify operational risks and develop mitigation plans.
* Support audit and governance activities as required.
**Requirements**
----------------


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in Technical Operations, IT Operations, System Support, Data Operations, or a related role.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Experience with ticketing systems and monitoring tools.
* Proficiency in SQL, Excel, or data analysis tools.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong programming skills, Net, Java, Python, JavaScript, etc.
* Strong experience with Monitoring tools: Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Cloudwatch, ELK, etc.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* Knowledge of scripting or automation tools (Python, PowerShell, Shell Scripting).
* Familiarity with ITIL, Agile, or DevOps methodologies.
* Experience supporting large\-scale production environments.

jobs.title: Senior Test Engineer II, Manufacturing Engineering
jobs.description:
**Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture.**


For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what's next, at the forefront of innovation and what's technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we're more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.


**Job's mission**



As a Senior Test Engineer, you'll play a critical role in turning breakthrough designs into real\-world manufacturing solutions. From concept to customer delivery, you'll drive new product industrialization by working cross\-functionally to optimize for quality, cost, and lead time. You'll be a strategic partner to both Global Operations and our Business Units, influencing design, improving processes, and supporting the full product lifecycle.

  


**What you will be working on**


* Design and develop cost\-effective testing methods with innovations on automation for systems and equipment testing throughout product development and manufacturing in meeting efficiency and customer quality requirements.
* Provide holistic technical solutions and drive standardization of testing methodology to produce consistent testing quality outcome in addressing testing needs across supplier, contract manufacturing, and internal manufacturing by liaising with cross functional teams in GOPS and Business Units (BU).
* Prepare test and diagnostic programs according to product requirements, refine detailed test specifications, develop detailed procedures, including assisting with the definition of test specifications with design / software engineering.
* Develop hardware and software for test fixtures, plan and coordinate test fixture sourcing activities as needed, debug and deploy test fixtures for production.
* Gathers operational and test data to evaluate test results; may take corrective/continuous improvement actions.
* Work with internal and external stakeholders to influence decisions and drive product testing improvements.

  


**What we are looking for**


* Bachelor's degree in electrical/electronic engineering, automation engineering or equivalent.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment, ideally 5 years in semiconductor capital equipment industry.
* Experience in testing optimization, including test case/option addition, automation and standardization initiatives
* Experience with control systems utilized in testing automation, serial communication protocols, TwinCAT PLC, DeviceNet, EtherCAT, RS 485, RS 232, etc.
* Working knowledge of testing methodology as well as programming languages such as C\#, Python, etc.
* Proven track record of managing technical projects to completion while accomplishing objectives and influencing cross\-functional teams
* Proficient in operational excellence tools such as FMEA, 8D, SPC and Six Sigma

  


**What sets you apart**


* Strong cross\-functional communication, stakeholder engagement, presentation and organization skills
* Experience in test automation for equipment product and IoT devices integration
* Exposure to manufacturing digitization and data\-driven process improvement

**Apply today to be part of what's next.**



We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what's possible through cutting\-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.



To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.



*ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*
